newsitem.title: UK: JAPANESE STOCKS IN LONDON MIXED AFTER WEAKER TOKYO.
newsitem.headline: JAPANESE STOCKS IN LONDON MIXED AFTER WEAKER TOKYO.

text.p: Japanese stocks traded in London were mixed on Thursday, weighed down by a weaker Tokyo market and with traders focused on currency moves.
Yet volume was very thin in London after the key Nikkei average index in Tokyo finished below 19,500 for the first time since May 1, hit by weakness in the construction sector.
"The mood in London was generally weaker and the currency didn't help much, consequently putting pressure on the blue chips," one trader said.
Fujitsu fell about 10 yen to 1,657.5 while Canon was unchanged to slightly higher than its close in Tokyo at 3,600.
The Nikkei 50 edged up 0.56 point or 0.03 percent to 1,676.21.
